title: Configuring Cisco Router Interfaces
summary: Configure IPv4 and IPv6 dual-stack addressing on multiple router GigabitEthernet interfaces, verify interface status, and test LAN connectivity.
learning_objectives: Configure IPv4 and IPv6 addresses with subnet masks and prefix lengths on router GigabitEthernet interfaces
Configure interface descriptions for documentation and operational clarity
Enable router interfaces using the no shutdown command
Verify interface status and IP assignments using show ip interface brief and show ipv6 interface brief
